verdict.rationale: JumpCloud's own IT-automation docs say its APIs and PowerShell module perform bulk operations across users, devices, and groups. Its RESTful commands cover directory, device, onboarding/offboarding, and event-export tasks, and an official GitHub repo provides supporting scripts and API examples. missing for 10: specific documentation of bulk endpoints or cmdlets and their limits, independent or hands-on corroboration that bulk operations work at scale.
